title: Comonad
description: JSON Schema for a comonad on a category C — an endofunctor T : C → C with counit ε : T ⇒ Id_C and comultiplication δ : T ⇒ T² satisfying coassociativity and counit laws (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. VI; Eilenberg & Moore 1965). Dual to monad. Specializes functor by adding the counit and comultiplication cells.

endofunctor.description: The endofunctor T : C → C that this comonad is structured on.

counit.description: The counit natural transformation ε : T ⇒ Id_C.

comultiplication.description: The comultiplication natural transformation δ : T ⇒ T².
